name: Español
_note: Spanish strings for self_model.py. WRITTEN BY THE AUTHOR, NOT YET READ BY A NATIVE SPEAKER (reviewed:false, same caveat as lexicons_data/es.json). Cues are accent-free (the utterance is accent-stripped before matching). Structure and keys are identical to self_model_en.json; tests/test_self_model.py runs the same fixture rows against both.
